title: GeoTrust
tagline: Trust based private location sharing sing encrypted compute power
description:
GeoTrust is social graph app that lets you share your location based on trust levels within your network. Perfect for event coordination, travel, and city exploration, GeoTrust ensures your privacy by allowing you to choose what information to share and with whom.

Key Features:
Trust-Based Sharing: Share your location by degrees of connection—first-degree (met in person), second-degree (connected through mutual contacts), and more.
Secure and Temporary: Share your exact location temporarily with trusted groups.
Dynamic Preferences: Adjust sharing settings for various scenarios, from high-trust event coordination to medium-trust coworking.
Encrypted Data: Store location data securely using encrypted compute power by Nillion
Trust Metrics: Build your trust profile with vouch points and soul-bound tokens.
Use Cases:
Event Coordination: Share your Uber location with group members attending the same event.
City Exploration: Share your city location with coworkers or similar circles while traveling.
Experience seamless and secure social sharing with GeoTrust.
how_its_made:
My React app uses Nillion's secure computation network to manage location data with three trust levels: 1 (most trusted), 2 (medium), 3 (general).

Key Points:
Secure Storage: Locations are encrypted and stored on Nillion's decentralized network, ensuring robust security.
Efficient Computation: Multi-Party Computation (MPC) allows encrypted data to be processed without decryption, maintaining security throughout.
Decentralized Trust: Data is distributed across multiple nodes, enhancing transparency and resilience without centralized control.
Benefits:
Enhanced Security: Data stays encrypted, avoiding vulnerabilities from decryption.
Efficient Processing: Encrypted data is processed directly, improving efficiency and security.
By integrating Nillion, our React app ensures secure, efficient, and decentralized handling of high-value location data.
